items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: Well, let's give you to Mr. Russell.

ctx.x: That's a dance. They dance, they hold a dress. Zolipon, Zolipon Mambo. Zolipon, gardez comme l'icard. Zolipon, ah, Zolipon Mambo. And then they put a bottle and they put over it like that. They say, Sayamaku Pesa. Sayamaku Pesa. That was some African song, I suppose. By damn trees. Well, let's give you to Mr. Russell.

That's an old picture we got from Raymond Burke that he found someplace. That's Congo Square. I don't know what that building is. In your mother's time, she said there was no building there. That might be on the edge of the square, too. It might be even on that street.
